question: Can moving only the row-owned 17x17 solve and residual arrays from per-thread registers to per-block shared memory reduce current epoch-kernel register pressure without altering arithmetic?

alternatives.A: Current fully fused warp solver, 250 registers/thread and zero local spill; control.
alternatives.B: Shared row arrays for the same FP64 Gaussian elimination and residual check; same event/integrator code; compile then real one-ms only if resources improve.
alternatives.C: Separate factorization/solve strategy or certified numerical integrator with independent operator residual and event checks; not this probe.

compile_falsifier: Reject B if compilation fails, local spill appears, or registers do not fall below 200 per thread. A compile resource improvement only permits a real-body fidelity/time pilot; it does not prove a speedup.
